name: Deere Company
tagline: Global leader in agricultural, turf, construction, and forestry equipment
hero_kpi_rationale: Indicateur maître de performance financière et santé commerciale de l'entreprise, reflétant la dynamique combinée des quatre segments opérationnels (PPA, SAT, CF, FS)

kpis.explanation: Total net sales and revenues across all operating segments
kpis.description: Chiffre d'affaires net consolidé de l'entreprise

kpis.explanation: Revenue from Production Precision Agriculture segment including 4WD/track and row crop tractors, harvesters, and specialty equipment
kpis.description: Revenu du segment Production Precision Agriculture couvrant les tracteurs, moissonneuses et équipements spécialisés

stories_kpis.explanation: Combined sales from Production Precision Agriculture and Small Agriculture Turf segments
stories_kpis.description: Ventes combinées des segments Agriculture et Turf (PPA et SAT)

stories_kpis.explanation: Revenue from Construction Forestry segment including earthmoving, forestry, and roadbuilding equipment
stories_kpis.description: Revenu du segment Construction Forestry couvrant les équipements de terrassement, foresterie et construction routière

ai_positioning.summary: Deere integrates automation, autonomy, and digitalization into equipment and service solutions, with emphasis on deeper technology integration to enable customers to do more with less. SaaS products represent emerging revenue stream.
evidence: Refined Leap Ambitions in December 2025 emphasizing automation, autonomy, digitalization, lifecycle solutions, and Solutions as a Service
Smart Industrial Operating Model supporting product quality and manufacturing excellence
Deeper integration of technology into equipment for improved profitability, productivity, and sustainability
ai_positioning.source: Form 10-K, Item 7 Management's Discussion and Analysis, Fiscal Year 2025

governance.voting_structure: The company has a dual-class stock structure with single and Class A common stock.
